message.content:
In panel E, under sham‑injury conditions the tau signal (green) is distributed in the extended neuronal processes (axons), whereas after TBI the tau signal becomes concentrated around the NeuN‑labeled neuronal somata, i.e., it shifts from the axonal compartment into the somatodendritic compartment. This indicates that TBI drives tau to mislocalize into the somatodendritic compartment.

[ANSWER]C[/ANSWER]
